messages:
Emily R: Hey team — hit a snag running the quickstart labs (hello-lab) while refreshing onboarding. The docs show the auth env var as `REDWOOD_API_KEY` but the starter app reads `RW_API_TOKEN`. Which one should we standardize on?
Jordan P: oof, leftover naming. I think most of our new SDK snippets use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`.
Sophie (docs): +1 to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` for consistency with the SDK examples. I can open a docs PR to update the text and the snippets.
Alex M: Also noticed CI for the sample app is failing on the deploy job — Dockerfile COPY path is wrong after the sample restructure. Error snippet: 
```
Error: COPY failed: stat /src/hello-lab/package.json: no such file or directory
```
Samira: Thanks for flagging. I moved files to `examples/hello-lab` last week; the Dockerfile expects `./` not `examples/hello-lab`. Quick fix: change `COPY package.json ./` -> `COPY examples/hello-lab/package.json ./` or move Dockerfile up.
Sophie (docs): For the docs changes I'll do two things in one PR: update all auth snippets to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add a short note under "Running locally" about adding the secret to GH Actions: `secrets.REDWOOD_API_KEY`. Also will update the Dockerfile note.
Emily R: Can we also add an inline code example showing how to read the var with SDK v7? Some folks copy/paste old patterns. Suggested snippet: 
```
// config.js
export default {
  client: createClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
}
```
Jordan P: perfect. Add a tiny test command in the quickstart: `npm run smoke` that hits the health endpoint so CI can smoke-test the sample on PRs.
Sophie (docs): Good call. I'll wire up a workflow job to run `npm ci && npm run build && npm run smoke` on PRs for the `examples/hello-lab` path.
deploy-bot: build 3299 of examples/hello-lab failed — see https://ci.internal/3299
Alex M: Once Sophie opens the PR ping me and I'll update the sample app repo (move Dockerfile and adjust paths) and add a note in the repo README about expected env var names.
Samira: Who's taking the ownership for verifying the migration guide? We should add a short section: "If you used RW_API_TOKEN before, rename to REDWOOD_API_KEY" and provide a one-line migration command for envs.
Sophie (docs): I'll include that migration blurb + a simple sed example: `git grep -l "RW_API_TOKEN" | xargs sed -i 's/RW_API_TOKEN/REDWOOD_API_KEY/g'` in the PR description.
Emily R: Awesome — timeline? If Sophie opens the PR today we can land docs + sample app changes tomorrow. I'll update the quickstart checklist after merge. :thumbsup:
Sophie (docs): Opening PR now — will post link.
Sophie (docs): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4128 — includes snippet updates, Dockerfile note, GH smoke job, and migration blurb.
Jordan P: reviewing now, small nits inline.
Alex M: I'll queue the sample app fix once docs PR is green.
Emily R: Thanks all, saved a new hire from a 20min rabbit hole :sweat_smile:
Samira: Nice. Can we also add a single-line note in the quickstart about secrets for local dev: `.env.local` should contain `REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` so the starter runs out of the box.
Sophie (docs): added that to the PR too.
Emily R: closing the loop — LGTM after Jordan's review.
Jordan P: done, approved.
Sophie (docs): merged and backported to the v2 quickstart branch.
Alex M: sample app PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/hello-lab/pull/987 — fixes Dockerfile and uses REDWOOD_API_KEY env.
deploy-bot: build 3305 completed for hello-lab (smoke tests passed)
Emily R: all green, thanks everyone! :rocket:
